project.name: osgi/domains/dataplan
project.description: The dataplan domain: the cluster ZFS dataset LAYOUT contract (dataplan-contract) plus the in-container export SCENARIO (dataplan-bdd) that materialises it. The storage twin of the netplan domain — where netplan owns the network underlay, dataplan owns the dataset layout under tank/rke2lab/*. Declared, not derived (no synthesis service), so contract + bdd only — no -core.
